_note: Edit before the first run. Agents search ONLY what is written here.
roles: FILL_ME role types you want, e.g. retail, hospitality, warehouse, customer service, delivery driver (employee)

portal_notes.SEEK: Quick apply. Use the portal's own apply form.
portal_notes.Indeed: Often shows a Cloudflare 'verify you are human' page: stop and report, never bypass. Search slowly.
portal_notes.Glassdoor: Easy Apply is routed through Indeed, so it hits the same Cloudflare check.
portal_notes.Jora: Quick apply only; NEVER use AI-assisted apply.
portal_notes.Zapid: Short forms; some need a video step (skip those).

priority_focus.recency: Prioritise ads listed in the last 1-3 days, then 7 days. Skip ads older than 14 days unless nothing newer is left.
priority_focus.order: 1) newest seasonal/casual, 2) other casual roles in your target areas, 3) everything else that qualifies.
